takeaways: The real cost of traditional development is the waiting: a process stuck in a long IT backlog keeps losing money every month, while low-code solutions can deliver the same requirements far faster and cheaper.

Citizen development scales safely only when professional architects build the guardrails, reusable components and secure connectors, and governance is organized in green, yellow and red zones with automated DLP enforcement.

With autonomous agents built in tools like Copilot Studio, the architect becomes the human in the loop who defines intent, monitors behavior and keeps business logic exposed through clean data and APIs.
hook: Hard-coded business logic and year-long IT backlogs have turned enterprise development into a liability. This episode is for IT leaders, architects and Power Platform teams who want to scale low-code without chaos. You will learn how citizen architects, zoned governance and agentic AI turn low-code into the new enterprise standard.
